prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Court Act, 1971, to initiate contempt proceedings against the Contemnor/respondent and punish him for the wilful disobedience of the order passed by this Court in W.P. (MD) No. 14777 of 2019, dated 23.04.2019.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— This Court by order dated 23.04.2019, directed the Authorities to constitute a Medical Board for examining the writ petitioner and for issuing a disability certificate. The order passed by this Court has been complied with and a certificate dated 21.05.2019 had been issued.

2. The petitioner's counsel would state that the formal copy of the certificate is yet to be issued. The respondent is directed to issue the original certificate dated 21.05.2019, forthwith, without any delay. If the certificate had already been issued, proper acknowledgment has been taken from the writ petitioner. The petitioner had already scored eligibility marks in NEET Exam held last year. It is open to the petitioner, as to whether on the strength of the marks secured last year, the petitioner can get an entry for this year. Therefore, all the contentions of the petitioner are left open. It is for the petitioner to work out his remedy independently.

3. Accordingly, the Contempt Petition stands closed. Consequently, connected sub-application is also closed.
